title: Repair shared conversation contract and safety coverage
requirements: Restore tasks/specs/BOT-009.json to the complete accepted BOT-009 task contract stored in pipeline state; do not leave a short pointer/status stub. Materialize the complete BOT-010 contract as tasks/specs/BOT-010.json.

Remove hard-coded human message copy from the conversation core. Public serialization must never include receipt_id or inquiry_id; keep those identifiers only in explicit trusted adapter metadata. Return a stable accepted-unconfirmed semantic code/screen that an adapter can render without implying confirmed time, admission or payment.

Validate ChannelContext at the conversation boundary before calling even a duck-typed gateway. Every action must enforce exact required and optional keys before indexing so malformed or missing payload data returns a typed GatewayError rather than KeyError, TypeError, AssertionError or another implementation exception.

When SET_REQUESTER has no self-reported contact, persist requester with name only and let the reviewed submit port derive the trusted current platform/sender contact. Never copy external_sender_id, platform, integration, conversation or event into draft answers. Preserve a supplied strict PHONE/TELEGRAM/VK contact only as self-reported contact.

Treat stored drafts as untrusted persistence input: validate exact allowed keys for each step, nested requester/contact and requested_time shapes, normalized values and the selected option against the current active catalog. Unknown step, extra/out-of-order fields, malformed nested values or inactive option returns CORRUPT_DRAFT or UNKNOWN_SERVICE_OPTION without mutation.

Preserve the original GatewayError object/code for VERSION_CONFLICT, IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH, RESULT_EXPIRED and availability errors. Ensure each mutating action invokes at most one gateway mutation and every rejection invokes none.

Replace the three broad happy-path tests with focused exhaustive pure coverage for Telegram/VK equivalence, OPEN/HANDOFF data, every transition and exact version/event, reset, contact omission/supply, beginner and experienced paths without gates, public serialization privacy, malformed/missing/extra actions, every corrupt draft step/shape, inactive options at selection/resume/submit, stable replay metadata, gateway error identity propagation, one mutation per success and zero on rejection.
acceptance: The shared conversation service has no hard-coded channel message copy and its public serialization cannot expose internal receipt or inquiry IDs.
Malformed actions and corrupt persisted drafts always fail with typed safe errors before mutation; trusted sender identifiers are never copied into draft answers.
Focused tests prove every BOT-009 contract branch, exact versions/events, error propagation and mutation count rather than only the happy path.
Focused conversation tests, scope and whitespace checks pass.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Required repair of privacy, strict validation and missing evidence before BOT-009 can be published.
